topic: Checklist: spot a mining offer that ignores costs
hook: Ask this one question before trusting any mining pitch.

scenes.narration: Electricity is typically a miner's largest ongoing cost, so an offer that skips it is incomplete.
Rewards are paid in BTC but costs are paid in fiat, so the price matters too.
Returns are never certain, so treat any promise of fixed earnings as a red flag.
Save this checklist and ask those three questions every time.

cta: What would you add to the list? Comment below, and my description link has the risks.
title: 3 Questions to Ask Before Any Mining Offer
description_body: Check electricity and fees, remember costs are paid in fiat, and be wary of promised returns.
